name: tiddlyrpg-plugins
description: Plugin bundle for the TiddlyRPG repo family: tiddlyrpg-core (format layer) and staticfiles (dev server assets); D&D content lives in TiddlyRPG-DnD. Includes a minimal edition for the boot/smoke check (npm run smoke), the tests in test/ (npm test; language packs and translation alone: npm run test-lang).
